Stream decoded outputs in submission order, retaining duplicate positions.

HTTP resolves authorized metadata; the storage adapter downloads and
verifies artifact bytes directly, a few downloads at a time and at most
twice that many ahead of the caller. ``output_name=None`` reads the
method's default output.

registered now, or with ``follow`` reads again every ``interval`` seconds
until the output is complete.

members.name: get
members.doc:
Get job by ID.

Notes
-----
This retrieves the job and loads it as a future so you can do `wait` and `get`.

Supported models-task records load the corresponding task future. Records
owned by compatibility schemas retain their compatibility future, including
when they carry provider and method metadata. GP training loads
`PredictorModel`, GP cross-validation loads `CVResultFuture`, and prompt
sampling loads `Prompt`. Each class documents its result contract. A
conflicting or unresolved models identity remains a generic, trackable
`TaskFuture`.

entries.name: TaskFuture
entries.doc:
Handle on a models API task job.

Results are keyed by unit position. ``get_item``/``stream``/``get`` fetch
a method's outputs, decoded by the codec each stored value names. The
method comes from the submission, else the job's ``provider_id`` and
``path``, else its job type. Reads go to the data routes by output name; an
unnamed output is the default the bare results route names. ``outputs``
come from the submitting method, then the job record, then the model
listing.

A job outside the models API has status and waiting here, and its results
through ``session.jobs.get``.

``dataset`` is the assay its sequences came from: as set, the one a future it
is set to carries, or else the one its args name.
